finding.query: TanStack AI system message composition chat streaming API
finding.pattern: TanStack AI's `chat()` function accepts `systemPrompts` array for multi-part system messages - System messages are sent as `role: 'system'` in the messages array - Supports streaming via SSE (Server-Sent Events) - Tools are defined separately from system prompts - Context injection through `messages` parameter with proper message structure - Provider-agnostic abstraction over different LLM APIs - Key API: `chat({ systemPrompts: [...], messages: [...], tools: [...] })`

finding.query: AI agent prompt caching strategies 2025 memoization performance
finding.pattern: AI prompt caching strategies in 2025: - Layer-based memoization: Cache stable layers (1-2) by config hash - WeakMap for memory-efficient caching (auto GC when no refs) - Cache key: `${layerType}_${configHash}_${timestamp}` - LRU eviction for dynamic content (Layer 3) - Context7 caching: Cache provider-specific system prompts - Pattern: Memoize layers until config changes, invalidate on tool updates - Performance: Avoid regenerating stable layers per chat message

finding.query: TanStack AI context injection RAG prompt patterns tools
finding.pattern: TanStack AI context injection patterns: - RAG integration via tools: fetch_context, search_knowledge_base - Server-side tools vs client-side tools execution model - Context window management: chunk large contexts, summarize files - Dynamic context: Layer 3 (Open Files) updates on file change events - File content retrieval: read file tool with max size limits - Project metadata integration via tool results - Message history integration with system prompts

Current codebase system prompt architecture: - Two-layer system in `system-prompt.ts` - Layer 1: TOOL_CONSTITUTION (hidden from UI, always included) - Layer 2: AGENT_MODES (user-selectable personas) - Factory pattern in `factory.ts` for agent creation - Integration point: `use-agent-chat-with-tools.ts` hook - No caching currently implemented - No dynamic context (Layer 3) for open files - Opportunity: Extend to 5-layer system with caching

finding.query: AI agent persona system prompts role-based agents 2025 multi-mode architecture
finding.pattern: Agent persona/system prompt patterns 2025: - Multi-agent systems: CrewAI, AutoGPT patterns - Role-based personas with clear behavioral boundaries - System prompts as security layer (reject harmful requests) - Persona switching without re-initialization - Multi-modal agent architectures (file ops, terminal, chat) - Human-in-the-loop with approval overlays - Best practice: Separate concern layers (security, behavior, context, user prefs)
